content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London's O2 arena ignited a fire that destroyed a van and heavily damaged a car and lorry. Firefighters were dispatched to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday, bringing the blaze under control after a little over an hour with 25 crews on scene and no injuries reported. The incident followed a pre‑planned filming activity close to the venue, which is slated to host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas the following week. The London Fire Brigade posted on X that the fire was now contained, noting the loss of one van, substantial damage to a car and lorry, and absence of casualties, adding that the flames originated from a controlled explosion on the set that spread unexpectedly. Crews remained on location for the rest of the evening. The yard lies near the Thames cable car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they were aware of reports of explosions heard in the vicinity of the O2 in Greenwich.
